flash_698135.description: Knicks coach Mike Brown praises Israeli NBA star Deni Avdija ahead of Portland's visit to New York, saying his team will need an exceptional defensive effort.

flash_698134.description: Shira Shapiro reveals that a government minister sent her a post from a social media user comparing her to her fallen son, Aner, and accusing her of harming the country. "There is a limit."

flash_698132.description: Suha Arafat, widow of former PA chairman Yasser Arafat, posts support for MK Ahmad Tibi, saying late husband would be proud of him. 'You learned his boldness, pride and courage from him.'

flash_698163.description: Police investigate alleged assault in Sheffield after campaigners confronted pro-Palestinian activists going door-to-door to promote a boycott of Israeli products.

flash_698162.description: The IDF identified three terrorists targeted yesterday in northern Gaza and later portrayed as aid workers, including an Islamic Jihad engineering platoon commander. One was fired by an international aid group following information from the IDF.

flash_698161.description: Antwerp Chief Rabbi Pinchas Leibush Padwa joins an interfaith initiative aimed at strengthening cooperation between Jewish and Muslim communities and combating religious hatred across Europe.

flash_698159.description: American Association of Jewish Lawyers and Jurists urges US Special Envoy on Combatting Antisemitism to reconsider visa status of church leader called "driving out the Jews" the answer.

flash_698157.description:
The chairman of the Religious Zionist faction, MK Itamar Eitam, expressed support for establishing a unity government that would include Netanyahu and Eisenkot, while maintaining continuity of government.

"We are in favor of a unity government. It is true that both the head of the largest party and the continuity of government will be maintained. I am against boycotts of Netanyahu and against boycotts of Eisenkot. I am in favor of them cooperating and finding the right path for the State of Israel," he said.

flash_698156.description:
Six people were injured this morning (Sunday) in a car accident between two vehicles on Partizanim Street in Be'er Sheva.

MDA medics and paramedics provided the injured with medical treatment and evacuated them to Soroka Hospital. Among the injured was a man about 40 years old in moderate condition, suffering from head and limb injuries, and five others who were lightly injured.

flash_698154.description: Three Jewish American soldiers buried under Christian crosses were honored at Arlington National Cemetery as their headstones were corrected more than a century after their deaths.

flash_698152.description:
China's Ministry of Commerce has announced that it opposes the United States Federal Communications Commission's (FCC) decision to prohibit Chinese telecommunications companies from gaining direct access to American phone numbers.

The decision is part of the steps taken by the American regulator to limit the activities of Chinese telecommunications companies in the American market.

flash_698151.description:
Bahrain called on the UN Security Council to take measures against Iran after an airstrike caused a fire and property damage at a civilian industrial facility in the kingdom. The Bahraini Foreign Ministry rejected the Revolutionary Guards' claim that the attack was aimed at American military radars, clarifying that the facility was used for civilian purposes only.

The ministry accused Tehran of exploiting conflicts with other parties to justify attacks on Bahraini territory, and emphasized that the kingdom reserves the right to defend itself, independently or in cooperation with its allies, at a time and place of its choosing, in accordance with the UN Charter and the Gulf States' mutual defense agreement.

flash_698149.description: Gilad Katz, Israel's former consul in Houston, warns Arutz Sheva that UK and Australian sanctions on Judea and Samaria groups could set a dangerous precedent, urging Israel to weigh security and intelligence leverage and signal a diplomatic cost.

flash_698147.description: Jay Shapiro highlights warnings from European Jewish leaders about antisemitism, examines a proposed shift from US military aid to strategic partnership, and reports on efforts to protect Jewish communities in Canada and America.

flash_698145.description: On campus, one conversation at a time, students gain the knowledge and confidence to speak up for the Jewish state. Opinion.

flash_698143.description: Hakeem Jeffries outlines plans for legislation targeting “Israeli settler violence", backs a two-state solution and discusses AIPAC funding and US arms sales.

flash_698141.description: The history of Jews under Islam exposes a convenient myth. The idea that Zionism destroyed a splendid coexistence between Jews and Muslims ignores a thousand years of history. Opinion.

flash_698139.description:
Deni Avdija returned to action on Saturday night after missing two consecutive games, but the Portland Trail Blazers suffered a 97-96 loss to the defending champion New York Knicks at Madison Square Garden. Avdija finished with 20 points, nine rebounds, and five assists.

Portland erased a 26-point deficit, and two free throws by Avdija gave the Trail Blazers a 96-94 lead with 3.2 seconds remaining. However, Mikal Bridges hit a three-pointer at the buzzer to give the Knicks a dramatic victory.

flash_698138.description: Documents reveal that a British university monitored a pro-Israel student and referred him to counter-terrorism police, who found no evidence of extremism.

flash_698136.description: German pro-Israel politician Karoline Preisler assaulted at a Berlin demonstration, prompting condemnation from German officials and Foreign Minister Sa’ar.

flash_698227.description: After more than four hours, the meeting between the Likud and Yashar negotiating teams has concluded.

flash_698226.description: In an episode of Common Sense: The Real Story with Shosh Bedrosian, Eitan Fischberger examines Drop Site News' funding, independence, and coverage of Israel and Gaza, raising questions about its editorial agenda.

flash_698224.description: Six firefighting crews dispatched to Jerusalem-bound Route 1 after bus catches fire.

flash_698222.description: Axios reporter Barak Ravid, citing a source with knowledge, reported that the Ukrainian SBU security service conducted the long-range strike against the Russian warship in Libya.

flash_698220.description:
A bus caught fire on Route 1 near the Hemed Interchange in the direction of Jerusalem, causing severe traffic.

Six firefighting crews from the Beit Shemesh area were dispatched to the scene and worked to extinguish the flames and prevent the fire from spreading to areas adjacent to the highway.

Route 1 is currently closed to traffic in the direction of Jerusalem.

flash_698218.description: Police arrest a 47-year-old Turkish tourist at the Temple Mount over suspected Hamas support, incitement to terrorism, and distributing money to worshippers.

flash_698216.description: Police rescue female IDF soldier trapped in violent haredi protest in Jerusalem, as rioters block roads, throw objects, and refuse to disperse.

flash_698214.description: The Chafetz Chaim, Rabbi Yisrael Meir Kagan, addresses this issue in his commentary on the Torah.

flash_698212.description: Prof. Asher Cohen explains Bennett's push for unity, his hopes for the post-Netanyahu era, and the political gamble that could determine his future.

flash_698210.description:
Iranian authorities will begin imposing daily restrictions on electricity consumption across the country, Mohammad Allahdad, head of Iran's national electricity company, announced.

Allahdad said that scheduled power outages would begin today, generally lasting less than two hours, between 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m.

He emphasized that essential facilities, such as medical centers and food supply centers, would be exempt from the restrictions.

flash_698209.description: Al Arabiya: Three children killed in Houthi drone strike in Aden, Yemen

flash_698208.description: Two Iranian nationals are accused of planning a terrorist attack against Jewish targets in Manchester, including a synagogue where two worshippers were murdered in 2025.

flash_698206.description: Costa Rican diplomat Rebeca Grynspan remains the leading candidate to become the next UN secretary-general, but opposition from two permanent Security Council members threatens her historic bid.

flash_698204.description: Aberdeen music producer Nick Cronin received the Scottish Album of the Year Award despite including a recording of an inflammatory anti-Israel speech in one of his tracks, drawing criticism from Scottish politicians.

flash_698202.description:
Former Agriculture Minister Avi Dichter attacked last night's events in Judea and Samaria, calling the rioters "a bunch of lawbreakers at best and terrorists at worst."

Dichter called for "using all tools to thwart terrorism to keep those rioters/terrorists away from Judea and Samaria, and preferably one hour earlier. Keep them away by all means, including administrative detentions."

flash_698201.description: Footage of a family reunion in Syria sparked an emotional response, but an investigation revealed that the man seen wearing an IDF uniform is not an active-duty or reserve officer, but an Israeli citizen serving in a security organization.

flash_698199.description: A north London woman allegedly left multiple voicemails containing antisemitic remarks about Jewish people and lawyer Mark Lewis. She is due in court next month.

flash_698251.description: MK Eitam calls on the Israeli Public Broadcasting Corporation to cancel an investigative report on IDF operations in Gaza, warning that its broadcast could endanger soldiers.

flash_698250.description: Why the "Change Bloc" succeeded, and how the faith-based leadership should shift from defensiveness to initiative in the fields of military enlistment, settlement, education, and Jewish identity. Op-ed;

flash_698248.description: Israeli citizen dies following a cardiac event while on a ski trip in France. ZAKA working with the Foreign Ministry and French authorities to arrange for his body to be repatriated.

flash_698246.description: Visiting his son MK Elisha Medan's Unity Tent, Rabbi Yaakov Medan urges Israelis to turn prayers for national unity into meaningful action and dialogue.

flash_698244.description: President Isaac Herzog welcomes Bolivian lawmakers following the renewal of diplomatic ties, calling for cooperation in security, science, agriculture, and other fields.

flash_698242.description: The IDF's Arabic-language spokeswoman revealed a surprise visit to a school in a Christian village in southern Lebanon, where she spoke with students about their hopes for the future.

flash_698240.description: Sources in the Yashar party and United Torah Judaism report progress in negotiations over the conscription bill following meetings held in the past 24 hours.

flash_698238.description: Dozens of bereaved siblings urge Yashar MK Elisaf Peretz to oppose any government relying on Arab parties, while remaining in the Knesset to fight it.

flash_698236.description: Delta Air Lines reports a malfunction in its automated aircraft weight and balance calculation system, causing flight delays across the United States.

flash_698234.description: Syrian mother secretly crosses checkpoints to bring her 20-month-old daughter to Israel for a second heart procedure, nine months after surgery saved her life.

flash_698232.description: At a Southern Command exercise, IDF Chief Eyal Zamir calls for more troops, warns of continued strain on reservists, and vows to pursue Hamas leaders.

flash_698230.description: The Yashar and Likud parties issued a joint statement following negotiations between their representatives. According to the statement, both sides presented their positions on a range of key issues and held detailed discussions. The parties agreed to hold a follow-up meeting.

flash_698228.description: Negotiating teams from Likud and Yashar meet for more than four hours, discuss judicial reform, a commission of inquiry, and the conscription law.

flash_698225.description: MK Ahmad Tibi draws criticism after meeting former Jordanian lawmaker Khalil Atiyeh, who has repeatedly burned Israeli flags and praised Tibi as a hero.

flash_698223.description: Rare manuscripts handwritten by Yemenite Jewish sages Rabbi Shalom Shabazi and Rabbi David Adani are displayed at Israel's National Library for a few hours.

flash_698260.description: Planning authorities will advance plans for 1,515 housing units in Karnei Shomron, Harasha, and Etz Efraim, including a new assisted living complex in Karnei Shomron.

flash_698259.description: Delta Air Lines restores an automated system after a malfunction disrupts flights nationwide, causing widespread delays as Thanksgiving travel begins.

flash_698258.description: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam accuses Israel of exploiting children for propaganda after an IDF spokeswoman's visit to a school in southern Lebanon.

flash_698256.description: National Traffic Police Commander Amir Jibli involved in a road accident near Ra'anana Junction in which a cyclist sustains moderate injuries.

flash_698254.description: A video allegedly filmed during a summit in China showing Russian President Vladimir Putin's bodyguards has gone viral, sparking speculation about their security tactics.

flash_698252.description: Trump says Iran has intensified its missile and drone attacks since the Democrats' midterm victory, while accusing Democrats of contributing to higher oil prices.

flash_698249.description:
MK Eliyasaf Peretz of the Yashar party responded to an offensive social media post about him that stated, "The successful brothers are gone, and we're left with the trash." Peretz replied that he had served nearly 500 days of reserve duty over the past three years and that his family had paid a heavy price. "We lost those dearest to us, but we did not lose faith in our path," he wrote.

Peretz emphasized that he remains a right-winger and that his decision to pursue a different political path does not change his values. "No one has a monopoly on love of the land, Zionism, or loyalty to the State of Israel," he wrote, calling for an end to hatred over political disagreements.

"We can disagree, criticize, and even be angry, but the hatred and venom must stop."

flash_698247.description:
Jerusalem District Police officers, Border Police personnel, and Special Patrol Unit forces are working to disperse a riot involving extremist haredi protesters on Bar-Ilan Street in Jerusalem, during which roads were blocked and infrastructure was damaged.

Police said that after an officer declared the gathering unlawful and ordered the demonstrators to leave, they refused to comply.

As a result, security forces began dispersing the protesters, using force and crowd-control measures.

flash_698243.description:
An Israeli citizen died following a cardiac event while on a ski vacation at the Val Thorens resort in France.

Members of the ZAKA international unit, in coordination with the Foreign Ministry, are working with local authorities in France to obtain the necessary permits and complete the procedures required to repatriate his body to Israel.

flash_698241.description: Eight years after surviving a brutal terrorist attack in Beit El, Neve Rotem recalls his fight for life and the mission he discovered through survival.

flash_698237.description: Libyan to Sky News Arabia: Two drones hit the Russian ship, and at least four drones intercepted

flash_698235.description: In Fox News interview, Trump signals possible renewed strikes on Iran in 2027, warns Iranian ships against challenging US blockade, and voices frustration with talks.

flash_698233.description: Record-long COP31 summit in Turkey ends without a global climate agreement as disputes over fossil fuels and funding for poorer nations derail talks.

flash_698231.description: Saudi-led coalition in Yemen intercept Houthi drone

flash_698302.description: Tzur Klinman, seriously wounded in Rafah, marries Moriah in an emotional ceremony as his mother honors the fallen soldiers who fought alongside him, including the soldier who saved his life.

flash_698301.description: Some 1.2 million women to be invited to complete a personalized risk assessment to help determine whether they need earlier screening, genetic testing, or specialist care.

flash_698299.description: At ELNET Jerusalem Summit, President Isaac Herzog calls attacks in Judea and Samaria 'despicable,' stresses importance of dialogue with Jordan and Egypt.

flash_698297.description: Ahead of winter and amid the ongoing war, Kyiv's Jewish community launches an outdoor advertising campaign urging residents not to leave elderly people alone.

flash_698295.description: Heated clashes break out as bereaved families are denied entry to a Knesset committee meeting and prevented from speaking before a vote. Lawmakers accuse the chair of silencing grieving families.

flash_698293.description: A Canadian Jewish group urgently appealed to the UN religious freedom representative over criminal proceedings against two haredi mohels in Antwerp. The community fears a doctors-only rule would harm freedom of worship and traditional observance.

flash_698291.description: Emirates tops TIME's global airline ranking, with no European carriers in the top 10. Turkish Airlines ranks 14th, while Israel's El Al fails to make the top 25.

flash_698288.description: Psychoanalyst Carl Jung understood the comfort of letting other people do one’s judging.

flash_698286.description: Be’er Yaakov couple detained after hospital examinations reveal injuries on infant daughter, police investigating.

flash_698284.description: Against the backdrop of clashes during the previous term, Knesset members and parliamentary advisers attend conference on the powers of legal advisers, ways to advance legislation.

flash_698282.description: A major redevelopment plan for Jerusalem's Talpiot industrial district includes 1,366 apartments, towers reaching 182 meters, and extensive commercial and public spaces.

flash_698280.description: State-funded public broadcaster faces sharp online criticism over its 'Mosquito Procedure' report, as users accuse Kan 11 of smearing IDF soldiers and putting them at risk internationally.

flash_698278.description: Slight cooling expected, with possible drizzle in the north and along the coast, and a temperature rise toward the weekend.

flash_698276.description: 'An educator is someone who knows how to admit a mistake,' Biala Rebbe says, expressing importance of setting a personal example and building trust between educators and their students.

flash_698274.description: Eight Palestinian Arabs without permits to enter Israel found hiding behind false wall in commercial vehicle; driver tries to flee.

flash_698272.description: IDF: Initial report - Sirens sound in the areas of Even Menachem and Shtula. The details are under review.

flash_698354.description: Ahead of renewed talks between Likud and Yashar, Bennett expresses support for efforts to form a unity government but warns against attempts to drag out negotiations.

flash_698353.description:
The Knesset plenum approved the Arrangements Committee's recommendation to establish four special committees, by a vote of 55 in favor and 36 against.

The committees are the Special Committee for Eradicating Crime and Violence in Arab Society, chaired by Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas; the Special Committee for Socioeconomic Equality, chaired by Joint List chairman Yousef Jabareen; the Special Committee for Oversight of the Implementation of the Law on Prosecution for the Events of the October 7 Massacre, chaired by MK Yulia Malinovsky (Yisrael Beytenu); and the Special Committee for Oversight of Efforts to Strengthen the Negev and Galilee, chaired by MK Noam Tibon (Together).

flash_698351.description: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, warns in an interview with New York Magazine that Israel risks becoming increasingly isolated on the world stage.

flash_698349.description: Yishai Sfez of Moshav Yated filmed himself opening a gate in the border fence with the Gaza Strip and entering Gaza, with no soldiers present. IDF: The incident is under investigation.

flash_698347.description: Shas faction chairman Yinon Azoulay asked in the Knesset plenum what had become of the harsh criticism Elazar Stern had leveled at the haredim before the elections. Watch

flash_698345.description: Six months after a Hezbollah explosive drone wounded him in Lebanon, Boaz Saluk of Kochav Hashahar is still working to rehabilitate his leg. In an emotional Arutz Sheva interview, his voice broke as he spoke of his wife's devoted support.

flash_698343.description: US Treasury sanctions two dozen-plus entities linked to Iran's shadow banking network, targeting billions in transactions used to evade restrictions.

flash_698341.description: Strikes against Hamas' veteran commanders have been accompanied by internal tensions over the allocation of roles and responsibilities within the terrorist organization, according to sources familiar with the matter.

flash_698339.description: Former Deputy Attorney General Raz Nizri is leading talks on behalf of Yashar with haredim, who are demanding legislation to halt arrests of draft evaders before the government is sworn in.

flash_698337.description: President Isaac Herzog speaks with Nvidia founder Jensen Huang following board decision reinstating him, praises his longstanding support for Israel and expresses hope for stronger ties with the technology giant.

flash_698335.description: Her father, Rabbi Menachem Mendel Leider, 75, died hours earlier. This morning, his daughter was found dead in an apartment in Bnei Brak.

flash_698333.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani backs sanctions on Jewish settlers and calls for a fundamental shift in US policy, accusing Washington of funding genocide.

flash_698331.description: Shneur Weber speaks with Hadar Miller about Israel's future, haredi conscription and fears of renewed unrest.

flash_698329.description: Amazon agrees to acquire technology from Israeli AI startup Decart in a reported $7.5 billion deal, bringing its founders and engineers on board.

flash_698327.description:
A 14-year-old boy was seriously injured while riding an electric bicycle in Barta'a.

The MDA team provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to HaEmek Hospital in Afula.

flash_698326.description: Maaleh Adumim petitions the Supreme Court to overturn the attorney general's latest delay of bids for 1,234 E1 homes until a new government is formed.

flash_698396.description: Strategic adviser Moshe Klughaft argues that Netanyahu wants to reverse the election results and hold another vote, and that only a credible threat of replacing him could change his position.

flash_698395.description: The Tanya compacts four millennia of Jewish wisdom to answer the great personal and existential questions of life. It has revolutionized the way we think about G -d the human soul, the world and our place in it.

flash_698394.description: The ultimate challenge in global tech projects in Israel lies in navigating the gap between corporate global culture and the volatile dynamics of the local real estate market.

flash_698392.description: The court found that an individual known to authorities for involvement in extortion effectively ran registered security firms that were used to transfer money to protection racketeers.

flash_698390.description: The employment rate among Hasidic women has jumped to 76%, but wages are lagging behind.

flash_698388.description: Jewish violence against innocent Palestinians endangers the settlements and serves terrorist organizations' propaganda. Opinion.

flash_698386.description: What caused Rachel's death while giving birth to Benjamin? An obstetrician-gynecologist's reading of the biblical verses suggests a possible complication during a breech birth.

flash_698384.description: US considers training Syrian forces despite documented abuses against Druze and Alawite minorities, potentially bringing American troops back in 2027.

flash_698382.description: I fear that one day, during the remaining two years of his presidency, Trump will wake up at nine in the morning and hear on the radio that the Shiite mullahs have built their nuclear bomb. Opinion.

flash_698375.description:
ABC News reported that US President Donald Trump's annual financial disclosure shows that he held at least $12 million worth of Nvidia shares at the end of 2025.

According to the report, more than 36 transactions involving the purchase and sale of Nvidia shares, worth millions of dollars, were carried out in Trump's accounts between the beginning of the year and September.

flash_698374.description: As a new cohort of combat soldiers enlists, the commander of the Combat Intelligence Collection Training Base explains how the teams operate, combining observation, drones and robotics.

flash_698373.description: Half-measures will not save us.You cannot deter a fanatical regime with half-measures, nor can you secure Israel’s borders while leaving the sponsor of our enemies intact. Opinion.

flash_698369.description: After a hyena was spotted roaming Modi'in and reportedly killed a dog, zoologist Dr. Haim Moyal explains what is driving the animal into residential areas.

flash_698367.description: New York's highest court rules that major social media companies cannot be held liable over accusations that their platforms helped radicalize gunman who carried out 2022 Buffalo massacre.
